meta.requirement: Explore Dawn Winery (30%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Adelinde's Order
start.text:
''A crate lies on the kitchen steps, clearly soaked and muddy. You notice a bunch of flowers, but they're stuck to the sides and wilted.''

Adelinde: Fuck. Fuck. WHO are you and why are you here? If you're looking for Master Diluc he's in the study. Leave me alone please I'm having a headache.

what_happened.text: Adelinde: Why do you care? Everything wrong happened. This was a REALLY EXPENSIVE order from Mondstadt with a bunch of flowers. Sweet flowers, calla lilies, you name it. It was meant to dress the hall for tomorrow because some bigshot merchants from Liyue are coming. Important ones at that too.

first_fuxking_triple_dot.text: Adelinde: The damned delivery guy apparently can't drive and somehow spilled ALL OF THIS into the mud. And now all the flowers are fucked.

choices.label: I can get replacements if you want need

replacments.text: Adelinde: Really? Holy shit you'd be a lifesaver. Well, if you can please hurry because Diluc doesn't know about this yet, and he'll be pissed when he finds out. Uhhh let me see if I can find the list of flowers for you one second.

second_rucking_dot.text:
Adelinde: Uhhh so it's twelve Sweet Flower, eight Calla Lily, five Cecilia, eight Windwheel Aster, eight Small Lamp Grass.

Adelinde: I think that's it.

i_gotchu.text: Adelinde: Thank you SO SO MUCH! You don't understand how important this is... I-i'll be in the courtyard until my shift is over, so if you get them please bring them there! I'll be sure to compensate you for your time... of course.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Adelinde 12 Sweet Flower, 8 Calla Lily, 5 Cecilia, 8 Windwheel Aster, and 8 Small Lamp Grass at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Talk to Adelinde

try_submit.text:
''Adelinde is in the courtyard pacing so hard the gravel''

Adelinde: Oh my god please tell me you got all the flowers.

choices.label: Got em all!
choices.itemReq: Need 12x[img:../Textures/Items/Item_Sweet_Flower.webp]'''Sweet Flower''', 8x[img:../Textures/Items/Item_Calla_Lily.webp]'''Calla Lily''', 5x[img:../Textures/Items/Cecilia_icon.webp]'''Cecilia''', 8x[img:../Textures/Items/Windwheel%20Aster_icon.png]'''Windwheel Aster''', 8x[img:../Textures/Items/Small%20Lamp%20Grass_icon.png]'''Small Lamp Grass'''

working_onvit.text: Adelinde: Okay. Okay fine. I'm not freaking out.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Adelinde 12 Sweet Flower, 8 Calla Lily, 5 Cecilia, 8 Windwheel Aster, and 8 Small Lamp Grass at Dawn Winery

got_em_all.text: Adelinde: HOLY shit. You actually did it. Diluc is never finding out and I am going to sleep for three days when this dinner is over. Thank you so much.

the_mf_third_fucking_dot.text:
''Just when you hand everything over, some slimes roll over towards you...''

Adelinde: Are you kidding me?? I was about to start arranging these!

choices.label: Let me handle them, give me a second

gimme_a_sec.text: Adelinde: Okay, okay. I'll head in first and start with the flowers, I'll leave the slimes to you. Thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Clear the slimes from the service path at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Clear the Slimes. Defeat 2 [[Anemo Slime]]s and 1 [[Cryo Slime]]

kill_slime.text: ''The path is gross but empty. You can see Adelinde peeking around the corner.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Adelinde at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Talk to Adelinde

talj_to_dhaknxlx.text: Adelinde: Are you okay? Well... wait I mean from the looks of it those slimes didn't do anything to you haha. I'm glad you're a lot stronger than I am, those slimes would've been trouble.

4th_dot_now_i_think.text: Adelinde: Oh wait! Let me get you something as compensation.

manor_ready.title: Manor Ready
manor_ready.text:
''You stand there and watch as Adelinde runs into the manor, then comes rushing out a few seconds later''

Adelinde: Thank you! Seriously.
